title: refactor: remove redundant Economics secret template
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Deletes the empty `env.example.json` key template
- Keeps the SOPS-encrypted `env.json` as the single provider-collection secret store
- Updates the local secret-store README
- Does not change, expose, rotate, revoke, or deploy any credential

gist.headline: One less empty hive cell
gist.blurb: The Economics ingest secrets folder now has one clear source of truth instead of an empty template buzzing nearby.
gist.summary: Removed the unused operations/economics/ingest/secrets/env.example.json template and updated its README, leaving the SOPS-encrypted env.json as the sole provider-collection secret store.
gist.impact: Internal secret-store setup is clearer, with no credentials changed, exposed, rotated, revoked, or deployed.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy secret garden shed with one clearly labeled locked seed jar representing the encrypted env.json store, while Polli tidies away an empty paper template; small code-plants and flowers show orderly maintenance without depicting any real credentials.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny gardener tool belt, carefully filing away an empty paper template beside one locked lime green (#ecf874) seed jar labeled in simple pixel text “ENV.JSON.” Code-plants, flowers, and a warm cream-and-lavender garden shed surround her; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful.
